_comment: OPTIONAL demo LIVE exam pack. Loaded into sample_questions as secure-exam rows (is_practice=0, published=1) ONLY when the environment variable SEED_DEMO_EXAM=true. Intended for evaluating the end-to-end exam sitting (browser runner + desktop client) on a fresh deployment. These are generic, publicly-known project-controls fundamentals — NOT the confidential live exam bank. For a real certification launch, leave SEED_DEMO_EXAM unset and author the true live bank privately via Admin Console -> Questions so answers are never committed to source control.

questions.question: A project entity reports total assets of $4,200,000 and total liabilities of $1,500,000. Applying the accounting equation, what is its equity?
For a control account the planned value (PV) is $100,000, earned value (EV) is $90,000 and actual cost (AC) is $110,000. What is the cost variance (CV)?
Earned value (EV) is $90,000 and actual cost (AC) is $120,000. What is the cost performance index (CPI)?
Earned value (EV) is $90,000 and planned value (PV) is $100,000. What is the schedule performance index (SPI)?
Budget at completion (BAC) is $1,000,000 and the CPI to date is 0.80. Assuming past cost efficiency continues, what is the estimate at completion (EAC = BAC / CPI)?
A negative schedule variance (SV) at the current data date indicates that the project is:
Under IFRS 15, revenue from a contract with a customer is recognised when (or as):
questions.option_b: cash is received from the customer

questions.question: Under IAS 37, a provision is recognised only when there is a present obligation from a past event, an outflow of resources is probable, and:
questions.option_b: the board has formally approved it
questions.option_c: the cash has already been paid
questions.option_d: a reliable estimate of the amount can be made

questions.question: Costs incurred to date are $600,000 and total estimated costs are $2,000,000. Using the input (cost-to-cost) method, what is the percentage complete?
On a contract, the amounts billed to the customer exceed the revenue recognised to date. In the statement of financial position this gives rise to a:
An asset costs $50,000, has a residual value of $5,000 and a useful life of 5 years. What is the annual straight-line depreciation charge?
Under ISO 31000, risk is defined as:
questions.option_a: the effect of uncertainty on objectives
questions.option_b: the probability of a financial loss
questions.option_c: any threat to the project schedule

questions.question: A risk has a 20% probability of occurring and a $50,000 cost impact if it does. What is its expected monetary value (EMV)?
An agile team completes 24 story points across three sprints. What is the team's average velocity?
Under the Scrum Guide, a Sprint is best described as:
questions.option_a: a phase gate that approves the project budget
questions.option_b: a milestone review held with the client
questions.option_c: a fixed time-box within which a usable increment is produced

questions.question: The critical path of a project network is best described as:
questions.option_a: the longest path through the network, which determines the shortest possible project duration
questions.option_b: the shortest path through the network
questions.option_c: the path containing the activities with the most total float
questions.option_d: the least-cost path through the network

questions.question: An activity has a total float of zero. This activity is:
Budget at completion (BAC) is $1,000,000, earned value (EV) is $400,000 and actual cost (AC) is $500,000. What is the to-complete performance index (TCPI) to finish on the original budget?
Budget at completion (BAC) is $1,000,000 and the estimate at completion (EAC) is $1,250,000. What is the variance at completion (VAC)?
In the procure-to-pay (P2P) cycle, a three-way match compares the purchase order, the goods-received note and the:
The order-to-cash (O2C) cycle typically ends with:
Under IAS 2, inventories are measured at:
questions.option_b: the lower of cost and net realisable value
questions.option_c: fair value less costs to sell

questions.question: In project controls, the governing principle 'AI proposes; the professional disposes' means that:
questions.option_a: the professional remains accountable for the final decision
questions.option_b: AI outputs can be accepted as always correct
questions.option_c: AI replaces the role of the cost engineer
questions.option_d: forecasts are automated and issued without human review
